definitions.short: properly, the crop gathered , i.e. (by implication) the autumn (and winter) season ; figuratively, ripeness of age
definitions.full: H2779. choreph חֹ֫רֶף noun masculine harvest-time, autumn (Arabic freshly gathered fruit, autumn (also rain of autumn or beginning of winter ) = Sabean (ןׅ חֿרפ DHM ZMG 1875, xxix. 597 ; Sabean חֿרפם חֿרף, = year , compare Ethiopic annus currens Os (Levy) ZMG 1865, 168, 174 DHM ZMG 1883, 369 ; Assyrian —arpu , Schr JPTh 1875, 341 KAT 253n. = COT i. 54 n .) — absolute ׳ח Zech 14:8 5 t.; suffix חָרְמִּי Job 29:4 ; — וָחֹרֶף קַיִץ Gen 8:22 (J), Psa 74:17 ; Zech 14:8 ; הַח ׳בֵּית autumn-house or palace Amos 3:15 ; Jer 36:22 (+ הַתְּשִׁיעִי בַּחֹדֶשׁ in the 9th month , i.e. Nov-Dec.); יַחֲרשׁ לֹא עָצֵל ׳מח Prov 20:4 a sluggard ploughs not after harvest ; as implying maturity, חָרְמִּי בִּימֵי Job 29:4 in the days of my autumn (prime).
